description: Universal parametric human and anthro figures for three.js and React Three Fiber: one CC0 base mesh, independent regional traits, subdivision, rigging, hair, clothing fit and a contextual tap-to-edit creator.
rules: The package is ESM-only and pre-release; the API is still in development.
Every figure derives from one adult CC0 base mesh; baby and child targets are excluded from the shipped data so non-adult proportions cannot be produced.
Regional trait masks keep traits independent: changing one region never locks or rescales another.
Subdivision runs in a Web Worker through the humanoid-kit/worker entry point.
The core entry point has no React dependency; React, React Three Fiber and drei are optional peers used only by humanoid-kit/react and humanoid-kit/editor.
